title: Solos, piano players and the best drummers
summary: Picou discusses solos in the old days, scarcity of piano players and drummers, and Louis Cottrell and others.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Another question. In the old days, did they play many solos? Like nowadays, they'll play a piece, the whole orchestra, and then maybe the trumpet will play a solo, the clarinet will play a solo, the trombone will play a solo. In the old days, did you keep playing all the time or did they have a few solos mixed in too? Well, that depends what number you're playing.
Did you have trouble finding piano players to play the right chords?
I see. It was hard to find piano players always. Yes, it is. Yes, it is. And was it...
Yeah, but in the old days it was hard too. Yeah. Was it also hard to find drummers that could keep the beat?
Oh, drummers. We got no more.
Yes. But in the old days it was easy to find a drummer.

Who were some of the best drummers? You mentioned the old man Cantrell. Is that Cantrell or Cottrell? Do you remember? Cottrell. How is it? Cottrell. Cottrell. Yes. Now the best drummer we got is Paul Barbarelli. Yes, he's a drummer. That's the best one right now, on the drum. Yes. Yes. He was a drummer. He beat the last one. He got... Pudum, pum, pum, pum.
Who were the best of them before? Alfonso? Louis Cantrell. Louis Cantrell. And there were other ones as good? That was the king. He was the king.
Were there other good drummers around at that time? No.

Oh, yes. They had... Let me see, what's his name again? I just mentioned... Oh, dear. Oh, Lord. He used to play with us. Murray. Oh, yes. Charlie Murray. Charlie? Murray. Johnny. Johnny. Johnny Murray. Was that the brother of the other... No, Murray. Murray. Murray. Murray. Oh, I can't make sure. Was his name Murray or Mac Murray or... Yes, Mac Murray. Mac Murray. Murray, yes. Murray. Murray. That was another good drum. Did you know Happy Chandler? Happy was good, too. Is he good? Yes. We used to play together at the theatre. What? The Laird theatre. Robichaux. With John Robichaux. Yes.
